AC amendment (gap analysis): Disambiguate absent-vs-empty handling. Add TDD case: 'Given key present but value empty string → return 3 (do NOT reject as <2)'. Specify exact stderr error format: 'planning.max_remediation_cycles must be >= 2 (got: <value>)' so task-2 harness can match.
Verify: bash -c 'source plugins/dso/hooks/lib/planning-config.sh && [ "$(get_max_remediation_cycles)" = "3" ]' && bash -c 'source plugins/dso/hooks/lib/planning-config.sh && get_max_remediation_cycles 2>&1 1>/dev/null'
